occurrences.text: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
